query:
SELECT 
  m.id,
  m.name,
  m.family,
  m.chemical_class,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pm.plant_id) as total_plant_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.conservation_status ORDER BY p.conservation_status SEPARATOR ', ') as statuses,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.name ORDER BY p.name SEPARATOR ' | ') as plant_names,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.latin_name ORDER BY p.latin_name SEPARATOR ' | ') as latin_names
FROM molecules m
JOIN plant_molecules pm ON pm.molecule_id = m.id
JOIN plants p ON p.id = pm.plant_id
WHERE p.conservation_status IN ('CR', 'EN', 'EX', 'EW')
GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.family, m.chemical_class
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pm.plant_id) = COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.conservation_status IN ('CR', 'EN', 'EX', 'EW') THEN pm.plant_id END)
ORDER BY 
  CASE MAX(p.conservation_status) WHEN 'EX' THEN 1 WHEN 'EW' THEN 2 WHEN 'CR' THEN 3 WHEN 'EN' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,
  m.name
LIMIT 60;
